interpolation.form: uniform Catmull-Rom basis per span with ghost end points, then the routine resampling; alpha=0.5 does not make the parameterisation centripetal
interpolation.linear_fallback: fewer than 4 control points: linear resampling (CatmullRomSpline._linear_resample)

validity.method: segment-to-segment distance between the sampled centerlines (validation/audit_distance.py), in double precision: minimum of the four endpoint-to-segment distances and of the interior candidate; interior candidate from n = d1 x d2 (line distance |r.n|/|n|) when |n|^2 > 1e-4 a e, otherwise golden-section search of the convex function dist(P(s), segment) down to |ds| <= 1e-14; minimised over every periodic image that can hold the minimum; clearance = distance - (r_i + r_j), a fiber against its own non-zero images: distance - 2 r_i. Numerical qualification by the V1/V2 tests against an exact rational oracle (|d - d_ref| <= 1e-12 max segment length on the tested cases); not a certified floating-point bound

sampling.form: uniform Catmull-Rom basis per span with ghost end points, then the routine resampling; alpha=0.5 does not make the parameterisation centripetal
sampling.linear_fallback: fewer than 4 control points: linear resampling (CatmullRomSpline._linear_resample)

validity.scope: sufficient condition for the tubes of the sampled centerline (flat-ended cylinders per segment and vertex sectors) to be disjoint, for the audit kernel qualified by V1; contact allowed when the requested clearance is zero
excluded_checks: continuous spline (only the 100-point centerline is audited)
self-intersections of a fiber with itself (zero shift not examined)
exact intersection predicate at flat ends (capsule test: conservative refusals possible)
separation or connectivity of fibers in the voxel grid
periodic exports needing shifts beyond -1/0/+1 (refused as undetermined)

pores.method: spherical pores grouped by identifier (periodic images must share centre modulo the cell and radius); pore-pore: centre distance under the minimum-image convention (exact for points, pore diameters below the smallest cell side required) minus the sum of radii; pore-fiber: exact point-to-segment distance from the pore centre to the 100-point sampled centerline, over every periodic shift whose fiber box can reach the pore, minus pore radius and fiber radius (capsule test: a sufficient condition for the flat-ended tube rasterised by the voxelizer)
